HackCamp · Nov 2025

Supportily

An empathetic mental health AI chatbot that checks in with you at the end of a long day. It gives you a non-judgmental space to vent and keeps the conversation going across sessions.

Smart memory

Older messages are summarized automatically, so long conversations keep their context without hitting token limits.

Crisis-safe design

Detects concerning language, rates its severity, and gently shows crisis resources when needed.

Non-clinical by design

It never presents itself as a therapist and encourages professional help for serious concerns.

Mood journal & stats

Rate your mood before and after each chat, then look back on summaries and trends.

Progress video · Episode 1

Formyoula

A fitness app that watches your squats through the camera, scores your depth and form rep by rep, and tracks your progress over time. I built it with Megan. This first episode shows how it works: live pose tracking that flags reps that don't go low enough.

Real-time pose detection

In-browser pose tracking with rep-by-rep scoring for depth and form faults.

Designed in Figma, shipped as an app

A web app built with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, packaged as a native mobile app with Capacitor.

Accounts & history

JWT auth with hashed passwords, saved session history, video uploads and a progress dashboard.

Reverse Trike

A three-wheeler built with friends, with two wheels at the front and one at the back. Episode 1 covers the start of the build: designing the frame and engine mount in CAD, then cutting, grinding and welding the steel frame together in the shop.

CAD first

The frame and engine mount were modeled before any metal was cut.

Hands-on fabrication

Documented as we go
